Design saved to [/tmp/exposed-kit-astra.md](/tmp/exposed-kit-astra.md).

Recommend one catchall server loader preserving the existing route union, server-only fetch/parsing modules, pure shared URL helpers, and adapter-node deployment.

Key risk: Kit navigation cancellation alone does not prevent stale results during the next debounce window. Compare loaded query/strictness against the current draft and prevent older loader data from resetting newer input. Playwright API interception must move to an upstream HTTP stub with isolated worker state.
